About the job

Magnet Forensics develops digital investigative software that acquires, analyzes,
and shares evidence from computers, smartphones, tablets, and IoT devices. Magnet
One is a cloud-based platform combining digital forensic tools, case management,
evidence storage, and collaboration workflows.

Role overview

We are hiring front-end, back-end, and full-stack Software Engineers.

What you'll do

- Analyze requirements, break down tasks, and estimate effort.
- Design robust, performant, and secure solutions.
- Develop efficient, modular, and maintainable software solutions.
- Participate in code reviews.
- Troubleshoot, debug, and fix defects.
- Take initiative, build strong teams, and communicate effectively.
- Guide best practices for building, delivering, and maintaining multiple source
  code projects.
- Understand product intent and use it to make product design and architecture
  decisions.

What we're looking for

- Professional software engineering experience.
- Strong full-stack development skills across front-end and back-end systems.
- React and modern front-end web development, including component design, state
  management, and responsive UI.
- C# server-side application development, including APIs, services, and data access.
- Writing and maintaining automated tests at various levels of abstraction.
- Cross-functional collaboration and communication with technical and non-technical
  stakeholders.
- Navigating ambiguity and adapting in a fast-changing environment.

Nice to have

- Python or other programming languages.
- Linux environments and shell scripting.
- Distributed data stores such as Elasticsearch, Redis, or PostgreSQL JSONB.
- Observability and monitoring with Prometheus, Grafana, or OpenTelemetry.
- Cloud-native systems, distributed services, and SaaS platform development.
- AWS, Kubernetes, and container-based deployment pipelines.
- AI technologies and workflows such as natural language search, agentic workflows,
  and using AI as part of the development process.
- Security-conscious or highly regulated environments.

Technologies

- .NET / C#
- AWS
- React, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS
- REST and GraphQL APIs
- Automated testing with xUnit, Jest, and PyTest
- Azure DevOps, GitLab, Git, and Jenkins
- Python
- Linux and shell scripting
- Docker and Kubernetes containerized services
- Infrastructure as code using CDK
- Distributed, message-driven systems
- Elasticsearch and search/indexing systems
- Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry
- AI coding tools such as Claude Code and Cursor
